description: This file defines the 'interfaces' package containing the 'AgentClient' interface for communicating with agent nodes, along with related data structures for MCP health, tools, agent status, and custom time parsing.

classes.name: FlexibleTime
classes.description: Custom time type that can unmarshal timestamps with or without timezone, with custom JSON marshaling and unmarshaling.

classes.name: MCPServerHealth
classes.description: Represents the health status of a single MCP server, including status, tool count, timestamps, and performance metrics.

classes.name: MCPSummary
classes.description: Aggregated MCP health metrics summarizing total servers, running servers, total tools, and overall health.

classes.name: MCPToolsResponse
classes.description: Response structure containing a list of MCP tools.

classes.name: MCPTool
classes.description: Details of a single MCP tool, including name, description, and input schema.

classes.name: MCPRestartResponse
classes.description: Response indicating success or failure of restarting an MCP server.

classes.name: AgentShutdownResponse
classes.description: Response from a shutdown request, including status, message, and optional shutdown details.

classes.name: AgentStatusResponse
classes.description: Provides detailed status information about an agent node, including uptime, process ID, version, resources, and MCP server info.

methods.name: UnmarshalJSON
methods.description: Custom JSON unmarshaling for FlexibleTime, parsing timestamps with or without timezone.

methods.name: MarshalJSON
methods.description: Custom JSON marshaling for FlexibleTime, formatting time in RFC3339Nano.
